title: "Introduction to Partial Differential Equations"
---

The study of partial differential equations (PDEs) is a fundamental area of 
mathematics that deals with functions of multiple variables and their rates 
of change.  PDEs are used to describe a wide range of physical phenomena, 
including heat conduction, fluid dynamics, electromagnetism, and quantum 
mechanics.  

The preliminary concepts necessary to understand PDEs include:

* Multivariable calculus.
* Ordinary differential equations (ODEs).
* Functional analysis.
* Measure theory.
